# pi-tools reviewing

Review is optional and risk-based. Use one fresh report-only `reviewer` for non-obvious or material uncertainty; public or compatibility effects; cross-owner or cross-domain work; security, concurrency, data-loss, migration, or destructive behavior; substantial refactoring or generated ownership; judgment-heavy verification; or divergence and merge effects. Low-risk, obvious, verified work may be self-reviewed.

<!-- awf:edit brief: default; create .awf/skills/parts/reviewing/brief.md to override -->
## Brief and result

Give the reviewer the relevant outcome and settled decisions, decision records, scratch plan, current-state claims, diff and integration effects, and verification evidence. Request risk-relevant coverage, not a ceremonial lens or pass count. It reports findings in consequence order with evidence, coverage, and uncertainty; it does not edit, commit, or change status.

Correct substantiated findings through implementation and verify the correction. Re-review only when the correction or later integration materially changes risk or leaves consequential uncertainty. A clean report is evidence, not a status transition.
